basePrompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: individual transparent PNG mascot logo for PACE product UI.
Input image 1: identity and illustration-style reference, NOT a background to reproduce.
Preserve the exact brand character: cute white fluffy curly-haired dog with drooping ears, round black shiny eyes with tiny white glints, small black oval nose, friendly curved black mouth, black-and-white tongue. Bold smooth rounded BLACK outlines, white flat fills, minimal interior curls, gray metal hammer with natural wood handle and a small bright yellow pencil as brand accents. Clean flat 2D hand-drawn vector-like artwork, no realistic fur, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no 3D.
Create ONE isolated coherent mascot logo, centered on a truly transparent background, square canvas with generous 12% safety margins, clear at small UI sizes. Keep proportions and face very faithful to the reference, keep lettering readable and spelled exactly PACE. Do not reproduce a dark background. No extra text, no scene background, no mockup, no grid, no watermark.
Scene:
scenes: Welcome and onboarding: the same dog smiling and waving one paw, other paw holding the familiar yellow pencil, leaning over a compact PACE wordmark.

Task running / building: the same dog concentrating happily at a tiny carpenter bench, one paw using the familiar gray hammer, the yellow pencil tucked by one ear; a small PACE wordmark on the front of the bench.

Task completed: the same dog holding up a neatly finished wooden plaque bearing PACE in the reference's white bubble letters with black outlines; proud smile, raised other paw, two tiny yellow celebration sparkles.

Knowledge search: the same dog examining a small open book with a magnifying glass; familiar yellow pencil next to the book; PACE on the book cover edge in white bubble letters outlined black; curious attentive face.

Empty state / waiting for first project: the same dog peeking into a small empty open toolbox, paws resting on its rim, gentle curious smile; PACE in reference white bubble letters with black outline on the toolbox; familiar hammer and yellow pencil neatly beside it.

Error / retry: the same dog carefully repairing a tiny disconnected wooden joint with its familiar gray hammer, yellow pencil beside it; slightly puzzled but reassuring friendly face, one small question mark; compact PACE wordmark below. No injury, no tears, no red.
usage: 业务场景设计预览；未接入正式前端。PNG 母版与透明 WebP 衍生图保留。

corrections.search: Change ONLY book cover blue to neutral steel gray, and pale blue magnifying glass lens to near-white gray; preserve all other details and transparent alpha.
corrections.empty: Change ONLY red toolbox body and lid to natural light wood beige; preserve all other details and transparent alpha.
